verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based coding agent. The evidence shows a headless mode that can be embedded in CI scripts or servers, Goals that keep it working until a judge marks the objective complete, and an optional browser provider. However, it documents no hosted or cloud agent and no workflow that builds, tests and produces a demo for review. Running it headless on your own server is a user-side arrangement, and the browser tools are building blocks rather than a demo feature.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
